head: PASSPORT countries visited app turns trips into passport stamps
dek: PASSPORT: Country Counter is a free iPhone app that turns every country you've visited into a stamp in a digital passport, with maps of the countries and US states you've seen. On a folding iPhone Duo it opens like a real passport, two pages at a time.
details: You can log return trips with dates, add notes and photos to a stamp, and share a card of your travels. The World Passport is free and needs no account. Version 1.2 on November 13 added two optional one-time purchases: a Parks Passport for all 64 US national parks and a Flight Log with airport stamps and estimated flight hours. It's made by Otas Temelis and needs iOS 18 or later.
where: App Store, iPhone, iOS 18 or later
means: If you like counting the countries you've been to, this keeps them as a stamp collection instead of a plain list.
todo: The World Passport is free, so you can add your countries before deciding whether the paid books are worth it.
